query_intent: resolve deduplicated clinic facilities inside a county boundary by comparing official HRSA/NPPES sources with community OSM data
fallback_options: run HRSA-only route without OSM comparison and disclose reduced source coverage
emit a GapRecord instead of a scorecard if no adapter for the area is available
ranking_explanation: Exact edge matches on the P0 clinic route rank first; the coverage-comparison group ranks as near match because its visible edge adds comparison outputs the query did not ask for; templates and overlays rank below concrete primitives because instantiation costs a build step. Ranking reflects edge-fit classes only; no runtime performance is claimed for any candidate.
